gable_construction.ridge_axis: Y (parallel to depth, perpendicular to facade)
gable_construction.ridge_note: Ridge runs from front face (Y=0) to back face (Y=D) at X=W/2. NOT a hip — two planes only.
gable_construction.anti_hip_note: A hip roof has 4 planes meeting at a shorter ridge. This construction has EXACTLY 2 slope planes + 2 triangular gable ends. The Extrusion.Create call below guarantees this.
gable_construction.construction_method: PolylineCurve triangle in Y=0 plane extruded by D along Y
gable_construction.python_source:
ext = rg.Extrusion.Create(rg.PolylineCurve([
    rg.Point3d(0, 0, H_WALL),
    rg.Point3d(W, 0, H_WALL),
    rg.Point3d(W/2, 0, H_WALL+RISE),
    rg.Point3d(0, 0, H_WALL)
]), D, True)
if ext: sc.doc.Objects.AddBrep(ext.ToBrep(True))
gable_construction.python_source_note: Triangle vertex order: left-eave → right-eave → ridge-peak → close. Extrusion.Create(curve, distance=D, cap=True). This creates a 3-sided brep: left slope + right slope + two triangular end caps. No hip.
gable_construction.impl_guidance_for_archie: SdRoof should: (1) define a triangular polyline in the face plane (Y=0), (2) extrude it by the building depth D along the Y axis. Do NOT use a 4-point roof that tapers to a ridge — that creates a hip. Do NOT use Box or offset operations on the wall top — those create flat or hip forms. Use Extrusion.Create with a triangle.

components.label: Villa Verde — 2-storey body + gable roof + bays + openings
components.note: SdRhinoScript runs via RhinoMCP run_python. WEB-CAD Skills tab will absorb this via parseGhDefJson.
components.source_inline:
# Villa Verde Typologia 2 — Certified iter7 construction
# Params: W, D, Hf, Nf, RISE, N_BAYS, WIN_W, WIN_H, DOOR_W
H_WALL=Hf*Nf; H_TOTAL=H_WALL+RISE
WIN_SILL=730.; DOOR_H=2100.
BAY_W=W/N_BAYS; bay_cx=[BAY_W*(i+.5) for i in range(int(N_BAYS))]
bay_div=[BAY_W*(i+1) for i in range(int(N_BAYS)-1)]
Y_WIN=-5.; Y_DIV=-6.
# Wall box
sc.doc.Objects.AddBrep(rg.Box(rg.Plane.WorldXY,rg.Interval(0,W),rg.Interval(0,D),rg.Interval(0,H_WALL)).ToBrep())
# GABLE roof: triangle in Y=0 plane extruded by D (NOT a hip)
ext=rg.Extrusion.Create(rg.PolylineCurve([rg.Point3d(0,0,H_WALL),rg.Point3d(W,0,H_WALL),rg.Point3d(W/2,0,H_WALL+RISE),rg.Point3d(0,0,H_WALL)]),D,True)
if ext: sc.doc.Objects.AddBrep(ext.ToBrep(True))
# Floor band at mid-wall
def rect_srf(cx,z0,w,h,color,y=Y_WIN):
    L=rs.AddLayer(f'VV_{int(cx)}_{int(z0)}_{int(y*10)}',color)
    rs.CurrentLayer(L)
    pts=[(cx-w/2,y,z0),(cx+w/2,y,z0),(cx+w/2,y,z0+h),(cx-w/2,y,z0+h),(cx-w/2,y,z0)]
    c=rs.AddPolyline(pts); s=rs.AddPlanarSrf([c]); rs.DeleteObject(c); return s
rect_srf(W/2,Hf-60.,W,120.,System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(65,60,55))
# GF: window | door(center) | window  (PARSED from DWG — door at bay1=center)
win_c=System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(40,85,140)
door_c=System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(80,65,50)
rect_srf(bay_cx[0],WIN_SILL,WIN_W,WIN_H,win_c)
rect_srf(bay_cx[1],0.,DOOR_W,DOOR_H,door_c)
rect_srf(bay_cx[2],WIN_SILL,WIN_W,WIN_H,win_c)
# UF: windows all bays
for bc in bay_cx: rect_srf(bc,Hf+WIN_SILL,WIN_W,WIN_H,win_c)
# Bay dividers
for xd in bay_div: rect_srf(xd,0.,80.,H_WALL,System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(55,50,45),y=Y_DIV)
